message: ADD CONSTRAINT EventType_userId_fkey FOREIGN KEY on EventType without NOT VALID requires a full table scan.
help: Postgres validates the FOREIGN KEY against every existing row, holding AccessExclusiveLock for the entire scan. On a large pre-existing table this blocks reads and writes for minutes. The two-step pattern is non-blocking: add the constraint with NOT VALID (catalog-only, ~millisecond lock), then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a separate migration which uses ShareUpdateExclusiveLock (doesn't block reads or writes).
